dataset.description: IDoFT (Illinois Dataset of Flaky Tests) Java benchmark aligned with FlakeFlagger 23 predictive features and group-aware median imputation (0 missing values, 17 projects retained)
reference_papers: Afeltra et al. (IEEE Access 2024) - A Large-Scale Empirical Investigation Into Cross-Project Flaky Test Prediction
Alshammari et al. (ICSE 2021) - FlakeFlagger: Predicting Flakiness Without Rerunning Tests

scheme_1_one_on_one_pairwise.name: One-on-One Pairwise Cross-Project Transfer Matrix
scheme_1_one_on_one_pairwise.description: Model dilatih semata-mata pada 1 proyek sumber tunggal (P_source) dan dievaluasi langsung pada 1 proyek target tunggal (P_target) untuk seluruh kombinasi pasangan (P_source != P_target).

scheme_2_repeated_afeltra_treatments.name: Repeated Leave-One-Project-Out Cross-Validation under Afeltra Paper Concept

treatments.T1_Baseline: Model cross-project konvensional tanpa transfer learning (MinMaxScaler + RandomUnderSampler + RF/XGB)
treatments.T2_Burak_Filter: Instance-based filtering menggunakan k-NN (k=10) pada manifold jarak Euclidean terstandarisasi
treatments.T3_TrAdaBoost_25: Transfer learning TrAdaBoost dengan 25% target adaptation data (75% evaluation)
treatments.T4_TrAdaBoost_50: Transfer learning TrAdaBoost dengan 50% target adaptation data (50% evaluation)
treatments.T5_TrAdaBoost_75: Transfer learning TrAdaBoost dengan 75% target adaptation data (25% evaluation - Konfigurasi Terbaik Afeltra 2024)
treatments.T6_Within_Project: Benchmark batas atas ideal (5-Fold Stratified Cross-Validation pada data proyek target)
